detail.longDescription: Hey, so this is more # AI fun! And by fun, I mean, rapacious bastards being rapacious. Y'all remember when # OpenAI announced they were adding advertising to # ChatGPT ? Then they decided to make the ads agentic? (More on *that* later.) And they label the cookie they place as "analytics" instead of "marketing", so it sidesteps some # infosec protocols? Who could have predicted that cookie is cross platform, scrapes entries and leaks data like a rusty bucket? Aside from everyone. The # NerdReich cannot be trusted. https:// cybersecuritynews.com/chatgpt- ad-tracking-cookie-follows-users/
